plain: In the Model Spec, the softest kind of default, which a user or developer can change even without saying so outright.
eli5: A suggestion, like "wear a hat when it is sunny", that changes as soon as it is obviously cloudy.
technical: The lowest Model Spec authority level with any content: Guideline-badged spec sections that developer or user instructions can override explicitly or implicitly when context clearly calls for it; despite the name it ranks at the bottom, the opposite of "Anthropic's guidelines", which rank third of four in Claude's constitution.
